purpose: Teach: マルコ/スティーブ/フィリップ/ムーア/ファーム/ヨシ/アール/服部

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがマルコ氏のイタリア料理本を読まれてるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is reading that Marco Polo Italian cookbook right now.
lines.style: Warm, conversational tone. Light, almost amused by his interest. Relaxed pace. A mother sharing what she's noticed about her husband.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと米国人スティーブ氏のドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched that documentary about Steve from America.
lines.style: Bright, eager clip to his words. Quick pace — he wants her to know. Genuine enthusiasm without performance. The natural bounce of a child sharing something he enjoyed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが英王室のフィリップ親王の追悼番組を観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is watching the memorial program about Prince Philip right now.
lines.style: Softer tone, more measured. A slight pause before speaking — acknowledging something quieter. Gentle delivery, like she's sharing something she's taken note of in him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとロックスターのムーアさんの曲聴いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I listened to music by that rockstar Moore.
lines.style: Quick, eager delivery. Slight breathiness on the opening. He's reporting in real-time excitement. Natural child's rhythm — wants approval and attention.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと野球のファーム見学イベントに行くそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father is going to a farm tour event with the baseball team.
lines.style: Calm, informative tone. A note of gentle amusement underneath — she finds his interests endearing. Unhurried pacing. The ease of a wife sharing her husband's plans.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとゲームのヨシ、つまりヨッシーで遊んだよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I played Yoshi — the game character — together.
lines.style: Bright, quick cadence. Small laugh underneath or after — proud of remembering the name. Eager child energy, slightly faster pace. Natural excitement about the shared moment.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアール、つまりRの筆記体を教えて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is teaching you the cursive letter R.
lines.style: Gentle, observant tone. Slight warmth on 'teaching' — she notices the care in what he does. Unhurried. A quiet appreciation for the small moments.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと服部半蔵の時代劇観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched that samurai period drama about Hattori Hanzo.
lines.style: Warm, satisfied delivery. A note of closure — he's coming to tell her before bed or winding down. Slightly slower pace than his earlier reports. Contentment, not urgency.
